title: Deep learning assessment of metastatic relapse risk from digitized breast cancer histological slides.
authors: Garberis, I; Gaury, V; Saillard, C; Drubay, D; Elgui, K; Schmauch, B; Jaeger, A; Herpin, L; Linhart, J; Sapateiro, M; Bernigole, F; Kamoun, A; Filiot, A; Tchita, O; Dubois, R; Auffret, M; Guillou, L; Bousaid, I; Azoulay, M; Lemonnier, J; Sefta, M; Everhard, S; Sarrazin, A; Reboud, J-F; Brulport, F; Dachary, J; Pistilli, B; Delaloge, S; Courtiol, P; Andre, F; Aubert, V; Lacroix-Triki, M
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习分析乳腺癌组织切片预测转移风险，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: Accurate risk stratification is critical for guiding treatment decisions in early breast cancer. We present an artificial intelligence (AI)-based tool that analyzes digitized tumor slides to predict 5-year metastasis-free survival (MFS) in patients with estrogen receptor-positive, HER2-negative (ER + /HER2 - ) early breast cancer (EBC). Our deep learning model, RlapsRisk BC, independently predicts MFS and provides significant prognostic value beyond traditional clinico-pathological variables (C-index 0.81 vs 0.76, p < 0.05). Applying a 5% MFS event probability threshold stratifies patients into low- and high-risk groups. After dichotomization, combining RlapsRisk BC with clinico-pathological factors increases cumulative sensitivity (0.69 vs 0.63) and dynamic specificity (0.80 vs 0.76) compared to clinical factors alone. Expert analysis of high-impact regions identified by the model highlights well-established morphological features, supporting its interpretability and biological relevance.
abstract_zh: 准确的风险分层对于指导早期乳腺癌的治疗决策至关重要。我们提出了一种基于人工智能（AI）的工具，通过分析数字化肿瘤切片来预测雌激素受体阳性、HER2阴性（ER + /HER2 - ）早期乳腺癌（EBC）患者的5年无转移生存期（MFS）。我们的深度学习模型RlapsRisk BC能够独立预测MFS，并在传统临床病理变量之外提供显著的预后价值（C指数0.81对比0.76，p < 0.05）。应用5%的MFS事件概率阈值将患者分为低风险和高风险组。在二分法后，将RlapsRisk BC与临床病理因素结合，相比单独使用临床因素，提高了累积敏感性（0.69对比0.63）和动态特异性（0.80对比0.76）。专家对模型识别的高影响区域的分析突显了公认的形态学特征，支持其可解释性和生物学相关性。
